notes: All failures retained. valid=false prevents acceptance claims, including records outside duplicate window.
Prior shared-tunnel points normalize final unique delivery by sender duration and include the receiver drain.
Missing percentage is sender sent minus final receiver unique; the receive window is finite.
Daemon CPU uses before/sent process ticks. Receiver CPU in the historical summary is normalized by sender duration; receiver CPU seconds and elapsed seconds are also retained.
TAP TX drops can count super-frame SKBs with USO input; do not interpret these as logical frame counts.
